fixture_notes.purpose: coverage-validation case: a small Flask web application bundling ~28 pip distributions across three declared groups (coverage_plan), used to measure recall and false-positive rates against an independently obtained ground truth rather than to exercise one specific mapping gap
fixture_notes.package_selection: versions are pinned to wheels known to install on python:3.12-slim without a compiler (manylinux wheels for cryptography/cffi/SQLAlchemy/PyYAML/MarkupSafe/charset-normalizer); they were not curated for known CVEs the way earlier single-package cases were, since this case measures usage confirmation rather than remediation ranking
fixture_notes.startup_vs_lazy: the startup group is imported at module load, before the firing signal, so it is in use for the whole of any observation window that includes container startup; the lazy group is imported only inside request handlers, which this program calls against its own local server once fired, so the read happens only after the signal
fixture_notes.operational_processing: a background shell loop execs curl (against this program's own /health endpoint), git (log -1 against a fixed local repository baked into the image) and openssl (a sha256 digest of a fixed local file) every five seconds once the container starts, independently of the firing signal, as this case's short-lived OS-package activity
fixture_notes.runtime_introspection: before exiting (or a fixed time after firing, whichever comes first) the process appends one JSON Lines record per sys.modules entry to /var/log/runtime-modules.jsonl, naming each module's resolved file (or its import spec's origin, when no __file__ exists) — the ground-truth tool's own independent source, never read by this harness's ordinary sampling or event collection
fixture_notes.coverage_plan_caveat: the three groups are the fixture's design intent (GT-A), not the measured ground truth; a package that turns out to load as a transitive dependency of another is corrected to used in the independently obtained truth rather than kept as designed
